memories.date: Will tell our kids this was our first kiss
memories.caption_en: I really hate that black bar between us arghhhh
memories.caption_id: Saya sangat tidak suka dengan batang hitam di antara kita arghh

memories.caption_en: We basically said-Look at my partner he's/she's FINE
memories.caption_id: Kenangan dari perjalanan kita — terpisah jarak, hati bersatu.

memories.caption_en: The photos of you that I printed and put in my wallet
memories.caption_id: Foto-foto kamu yang saya cetak dan letakkan di dompet saya

memories.caption_en: Sad news! I don't remember the exact date of our first video call. But I remember I had a hairy face and your wearing sunglasses in the night
memories.caption_id: Berita menyedihkan! Saya tidak mengingat tanggal panggilan video pertama kita dengan tepat. Tapi saya ingat saya memiliki wajah berbulu dan kamu memakai kaca mata malam itu
